description: This file defines the ImplementedInterfaceProvider class which populates properties with grain interface types implemented by a grain class, including methods for populating interface info and identifying grain interfaces.

classes.name: ImplementedInterfaceProvider
classes.description: Provides functionality to identify and populate grain interface properties for a given grain class.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Populates the provided properties dictionary with interface IDs for each grain interface implemented by the grain class.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Generates a property key string based on the counter index.

methods.name: IsGrainInterface
methods.description: Determines whether a given type is a grain interface type.
